This '''[[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]]''' was a vessel used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The ship had [[Wikipedia:Nose art|nose art]] of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] armed with a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]].

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the gunship was part of a taskforce which [[Battle of Ukio|inspected]] the [[Ukian/Legends|Ukian]] [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] shield.
